_notes: Per-species behaviours (P2.6), read by FishBrain through its behaviorUri field on top of config/brain.json (which keeps the motion parameters, lane and ellipses). species maps a species to a kind; a species not listed, or a kind not in kinds, cruises exactly as in P2.3 (clownfish until P4 anemone hosting). Times are seconds ([min, max] ranges are drawn per state), speeds px/s, positions scene pixels of the fish anchor (rig mirror_center). caves: mouth is where the fish hovers, den is where it backs to, both outside every brain.json ellipse; out is the side the opening faces (+1 right, -1 left) and pins the fish's facing in every cave state, so retreat moves tail first. rocks are graze points just outside the ellipses. band is the rock/sand edge rect the bottom kind never leaves. hover.drift and hover.hang override brain.json motion fields for those modes. arriveTime and arriveResponse shape arrive steering (desired speed = distance / arriveTime, closed at arriveResponse per second). population is the BehaviorDemoScene mix (FishBrain uses it instead of brain.json species/count); the tank's per-density population lands in scene.json with P2.7.
